semiconductor_relevance: High — Zhuolida Advanced Semiconductor specializes in the renovation and regeneration of semiconductor manufacturing components, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
summary: Zhuolida Advanced Semiconductor (Nantong) Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise focused on the renovation and regeneration of semiconductor manufacturing components, including precision metal etching and laser cutting. Their services are critical for maintaining and enhancing the performance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

regional_presence.China: Zhuolida is based in Nantong, China, and has served many of the world's top 500 enterprises.
